detail.longDescription: Do you actually need an AI agent? AI agents can automate multi-step tasks, connect tools, and handle work with less manual input. But more automation doesn’t always mean a better workflow. Sometimes a simple AI tool or well-designed workflow is enough. I explored when AI agents are actually useful — and when you probably don’t need one.
